title: Concept: Perl object graph restored from untrusted bytes in perl — review required
description: In perl, a Storable stream is thawed. The format preserves object identity and class names, so restoration can construct blessed objects whose methods run during or after loading. Treating the stream as data while the library treats it as code is the root of the confusion.
applicability: perl services that cache or exchange serialized structures.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution; HIGH severity.
